verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can split the inbox into focused areas and design their own categories such as "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team". Auto Labels classify mail on arrival and separate marketing, and custom Auto Labels can be turned into split-inbox tabs, so triage can follow priority rather than arrival order. A community user corroborates that promotional mail is routed to a separate 'other' folder. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of custom split tabs and priority-ordered triage, and custom AI-prompt Auto Labels are limited to Business and Enterprise plans.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".
you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.
splitting your inbox allows you to divide your inbox into different areas of focus
Superhuman AI will automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates, so you can respond faster to what matters most.
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
